reasoning_trace.value: The paper proposes a linearly polarized mode demultiplexing hybrid (MDH) based on multi-plane light conversion technology for mode division multiplexing (MDM) coherent fiber communication systems. The MDH enables simultaneous mode demultiplexing of six modes and optical 90-deg mixing using seven phase plates. The system mechanism involves the wavefront matching algorithm to accurately calculate the phase mask in each phase plate, allowing for efficient conversion between modes.
